howToAdd: To add a project, copy one block from "projects" below, paste it at the top of the list and change the values.
types: pick one or more of Analytics, Data Engineering, Machine Learning, Dashboards (new types become new filter chips automatically).
tools: any tools you used; each one becomes a filter chip with a count.
status: Shipped, In progress or Live.  year: a number like 2026.
links: leave out any you don't have. caseStudy is a page on this site (like /work/fraud), code is a GitHub link, live is a demo link.
featured: true also shows the project in the big layout at the top of Projects (that part is edited in components/markup.ts).

projects.title: Impact dashboard for a medical-equipment nonprofit
projects.summary: A nightly pipeline pulls form data through an API, loads PostgreSQL in raw, cleaned and reporting layers, and feeds a dashboard plus automatic donor reports.

projects.title: This Website’s Own Data Pipeline
projects.summary: Every visit is logged as a cookieless event in PostgreSQL, rolled into reporting tables each night by GitHub Actions, and shown on a public dashboard.

projects.title: Fraud Operations Decision Intelligence
projects.summary: Scores fraud alerts with a logistic regression model on PostgreSQL and serves a ranked queue in Streamlit, so analysts review the riskiest cases first.
